The Acme platform

The platform has three parts. Ingest takes carrier EDI, telematics and terminal feeds and normalises them. The timeline service reconciles conflicting events into one ordered history per shipment, which is harder than it sounds when a carrier reports a delivery two hours before the GPS trace says the truck arrived. Alerting scores each shipment for risk of missing its window.

It runs on Postgres and Kafka, with the ingest workers in Go and the timeline and alerting services in Node.js. We deploy to Kubernetes several times a day.
